guidebook.intro: Nnyonnyola olunaku lwo okuva ku makya okutuuka ekiro: okuzuukuka, emirimu, okufumba n’okwebaka.

tips.title: Ebikolebwa buli lunaku
body: Ku bintu by’okola buli lunaku, kozesa ekikolwa nga bwe kiri: **I wake up at six. I work every day.**
**Always** kijja wakati w’omuntu n’ekikolwa: **I always drink tea.**

tips.title: “He works” ayongerako -s
body: Mu Luganda entandikwa y’ekikolwa ekyuka: **nkola, akola, tukola, bakola**. Mu Lungereza ekikolwa tekikyuka, okuggyako ku **he**, **she** ne **it**, bw’oyongerako **-s**.

culture.title: Emmere essatu
body: **Breakfast** (ekyenkya), **lunch** (ekyemisana) ne **dinner** (ekyeggulo). Mu Lungereza abantu batera okugamba **have**: **I have breakfast at seven.** Kye kimu ne **I eat breakfast**.
